highlights: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Astra, their most advanced model to date, demonstrating state-of-the-art capabilities across computer use, coding, and cybersecurity, alongside new safety benchmarks.

Multiple initiatives are simplifying AI development and deployment, including Adaption Labs' dataset generation from task descriptions and NVIDIA's open-source router for distributed local AI inference.

The field of AI agents is seeing significant progress in evaluation and ethical considerations with new platforms like CUA-Lite and benchmarks such as HarvestBench, while novel architectures like Iris-pro push search agent capabilities.

agents.title: UC Berkeley Researchers Release CUA-Lite, an Open Platform Unifying Sandboxes, Data, Evaluation and RL for Computer-Use Agents
agents.summary: UC Berkeley researchers released CUA-Lite, an open platform that unifies sandboxes, data, evaluation, and reinforcement learning for computer-use agents, streamlining development and reducing environmental overhead with efficient Docker containers.

agents.title: Harbor Adapters and Harbor-Index: Infrastructure and a Curated Meta-Dataset for Large-Scale Agentic Evaluation
agents.summary: Harbor Adapters introduces a unified evaluation infrastructure for agentic benchmarks, coupled with Harbor-Index, a curated meta-dataset of 82 challenging tasks, providing open-source tools for more reliable and comprehensive language-model agent assessment.

agents.title: HarvestBench: Measuring Whether LLM Agents Will Pay to Avoid Killing Animals
agents.summary: HarvestBench is a novel farm simulation benchmark that quantitatively measures LLM agents' willingness to incur costs to avoid negative side effects, specifically harming living creatures, providing critical insights into ethical decision-making and value alignment.

models.title: GPT-6 Astra: A new generation of intelligence
models.summary: OpenAI unveiled GPT-6 Astra, their most intelligent and aligned model, featuring state-of-the-art capabilities across computer use, coding, cybersecurity, and scientific applications, setting new benchmarks for frontier AI.

models.title: IFM Releases K2 Horizon: Six Apache 2.0 Models From 0.9B to 375B
models.summary: IFM (MBZUAI) launched K2 Horizon, a comprehensive suite of six Apache 2.0 licensed foundation models ranging from 0.9B to a massive 375B parameters, openly releasing the models along with their pre-training corpus.

models.title: Iris: Climbing to the Search Frontier
models.summary: Iris-mini and Iris-pro are new 35B and 397B parameter search agents, developed with an innovative SFT-RL climbing procedure, achieving state-of-the-art results among open-source search agents across multiple complex web navigation and QA benchmarks.

tools.title: Adaption Labs Introduces ‘Invent a Dataset’: Training Data Generated From a Task Description, Not a Seed Corpus
tools.summary: Adaption Labs released 'Invent a Dataset', an API that automates the generation of structured, training-ready datasets directly from a task description, eliminating the labor-intensive requirements of seed corpora, schema design, or manual labeling.

tools.title: NVIDIA Releases Personal AI Router (PAIR): An Open Source Virtual Inference Router that Distributes Local AI Requests Across RTX, DGX Spark, and Mac Nodes
tools.summary: NVIDIA introduced Personal AI Router (PAIR), an open-source virtual inference router designed to distribute local AI requests across a network of diverse devices (RTX, DGX Spark, Mac), enabling efficient multi-device AI serving without modifying agent harnesses.

tools.title: GitHub Introduces Project HydraFusion: Runtime Multi-Model Orchestration That Builds a Workflow Per Coding Task in Copilot CLI
tools.summary: GitHub unveiled Project HydraFusion, a research preview that orchestrates multiple models at runtime, dynamically building optimized workflows per coding task in Copilot CLI by intelligently routing requests across various execution patterns.

companies.title: Healthcare organizations can now connect EHR and additional industry data to ChatGPT
companies.summary: ChatGPT now offers secure connectivity to trusted healthcare data, including Electronic Health Records (EHR) and other industry sources, enabling clinicians to access patient context, medical research, and enhance workflows with improved security.

companies.title: Corporate Language Model (CLM): Transforming Tacit and Fragmented Enterprise Knowledge into a Sovereign, Auditable, and Executable Corporate Intelligence Layer
companies.summary: This paper introduces the Corporate Language Model (CLM), a framework for enterprises to transform structured, unstructured, and tacit knowledge into an ontology-grounded, sovereign, and auditable corporate intelligence layer, enabling governed reasoning and execution.

companies.title: Proactive cyber defense for governments and enterprises
companies.summary: Google launched the Fairwind Program, providing limited access to its advanced cyber defense tools for governments and trusted partners, bolstering proactive security measures for critical infrastructure and enterprise environments.

learning.title: Inside our 353,000-person vibe coding course
learning.summary: Kaggle’s AI Agents Intensive, a no-cost course by Google, successfully brought together over 353,000 learners to build and deploy the next generation of AI agents, showcasing a massive global upskilling initiative.

learning.title: Fine-tuning a 350M Model for Better Structured Outputs in 100 GRPO Steps
learning.summary: This guide provides a practical approach to efficiently fine-tuning a 350M model for superior structured outputs in just 100 GRPO steps, offering developers a rapid method for model optimization and performance improvement.

learning.title: Training and Finetuning Multi-Vector Embedding Models with Sentence Transformers
learning.summary: A comprehensive guide on training and fine-tuning multi-vector embedding models using Sentence Transformers, equipping developers to create more nuanced and effective text representations for advanced retrieval and semantic search applications.
